Application for Licence to Possess a Firearm – SAPS 271

Download the SAPS 271 application for licence to possess a firearm in South Africa. This is the official blank PDF form required when applying for a firearm licence through SAPS.

The SAPS 271 form is the official application used when applying for a licence to possess a firearm in South Africa. It must be completed and submitted together with your supporting documents as part of your firearm licence application process. Use the download button below to open and save the blank PDF so you can complete it accurately before submission to SAPS.
